meta.title: Michelin Guide — Las Vegas, 2026 Southwest selection
meta.important_note: Las Vegas had NO Michelin Guide between 2010 and 2025. The 2026 Southwest selection (announced 31 Aug 2026 on michelin.com; the ceremony was held at Fontainebleau Las Vegas) is the first Las Vegas guide since 2009. Many older 'Michelin' claims online are stale.
meta.price_rule: price_2adults is ONLY filled where the venue's own page or its own hosted menu PDF stated a per-person or for-two price on 2026-11-27, or where a defensible range can be computed from prices the venue prints (the arithmetic is stored in price_calc). Blank = not verified. '++' means plus tax and gratuity, as printed by the venue.
meta.social_rule: A handle is published only after this session fetched the Instagram profile itself and it matched the venue (bio names the restaurant, or the venue's own website links to it). Decoys were rejected: @stubbornseedvegas (7 followers), @pingpangpong (a private personal account), @phogabacbac (1 follower). Blank means no official handle was verified — never guessed. See FLAGS.md F-19.

announcement_date.note: Corrected 2026-11-26; earlier copies of this dataset said 26 Aug 2026 (F-51).

verified_2026_11_27.what: Couple-price pass (9 venues filled from official menus), hours re-confirmation (9 venues), and Instagram verification (16 venue rows).
verified_2026_11_27.price_sources: Each row carries price_source. Values were read, not inferred.

restaurants.name: Joël Robuchon
restaurants.address: 3799 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
restaurants.exceptions: Closed Sunday and Monday. No children under 6 in the reservation. Business formal dress code.
restaurants.price_note: Menu prices are not published on the official page. Reserve and confirm.
restaurants.notes: Two independent creator videos in this dataset claim three Michelin stars — that is the pre-2010 status. The 2026 Guide lists Joël Robuchon at TWO stars, which the restaurant's own page also states. NOTE: the same page carries a dated banner ("open 4:00–8:00 PM Thu 19 – Sat 21 November") that applies to a 2026 date, not to 2027 — do not carry it forward. Also the 2026 MICHELIN Service Award went to GM Sean Christopher, so award rows and staff awards must not be confused. Reservations number 702.891.7925 printed on the official MGM Grand page (verified 2026-11-26).

restaurants.name: Michael Mina
restaurants.address: 3600 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
restaurants.exceptions: The Bellagio page's Hours of operation block reads "Monday to Sunday: Closed" and the restaurant is labelled Temporarily closed. Published seasonal closures on the same page: 22–30 Nov; 6–8, 13–15 and 20–22 Dec 2026.
restaurants.price_note: 10-course tasting menu at $295++ per person, from the official page. Two adults = $590 before tax and gratuity.
restaurants.notes: SERIOUS: the restaurant's own page shows "Temporarily closed" for all seven days, so the $590++ tasting-menu figure on this row is a price for a service that is not currently running. This row must not be presented as a bookable option without a re-check. Reopen date is not published. Do not assume it reopens before Feb 2027. Re-checked 2026-11-26: Bellagio's own dining index (bellagio.mgmresorts.com/en/restaurants.html?filter=property,Bellagio_Las_Vegas) lists Michael Mina as 'Temporarily Closed' with a $$$$ seafood label. No reopen date is published (F-23, F-43).

restaurants.name: Partage
restaurants.address: 3839 Spring Mountain Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89102
restaurants.exceptions: Closed Sunday and Monday. Prix fixe only (5, 7 or 9 courses). No dairy-free, vegan, vegetarian, coeliac, or onion/garlic-free menus — a real constraint, not a preference.
restaurants.price_note: Official Partage menu page (partage.vegas/menu): 5 courses $130, 7 courses $160, Signature 9-course $210 per person. Two adults = $260 / $320 / $420 before tax and gratuity. Seared foie gras add-on +$33 per guest; wine pairings $60 to $125 per person.
restaurants.notes: Hours and phone are on the Contact page, not the Restaurant page — the Restaurant page is a booking widget and shows no service times. Strict dietary policy: decide before booking. OpenTable id 1005940. Phone 702-582-5852.
restaurants.hours_source: https://partage.vegas/contact ("We'll be open for the foreseeable future Tuesday to Saturday from 5 pm to 9 pm.", retrieved 2026-11-25)
restaurants.price_basis: 2 x printed per-person tasting-menu price (official venue page)

restaurants.name: Sparrow + Wolf
restaurants.address: 4480 Spring Mountain Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89102
restaurants.exceptions: Cancellations inside 24 hours are charged $25 per guest.
